30: Here [It] Is [Scenario] When The Rung Has Been Fastened - If the rung completely filled the hole into which it was wedged, and it grasps it very well, then there is no downward motion, and he would thus be exempt  [from exile]. If [however] it is not [securely] fastened, then there would be a downward motion, resulting in liability [i.e. exile].
